import pandas as pd

# Ensure order_date is datetime
sales['order_date'] = pd.to_datetime(sales['order_date'])

# Filter for 2024 and 2025
sales_24_25 = sales[sales['order_date'].dt.year.isin([2024, 2025])].copy()
sales_24_25['year'] = sales_24_25['order_date'].dt.year

# Aggregate revenue
rev_summary = sales_24_25.groupby(['region', 'year'])['revenue'].sum().unstack()

# Calculate growth
rev_summary['growth_pct'] = ((rev_summary[2025] - rev_summary[2024]) / rev_summary[2024]) * 100

print(rev_summary)

# Visualize
growth_df = rev_summary.reset_index()
fig = px.bar(growth_df, x='region', y='growth_pct', 
             title='Revenue Growth by Region (2024 to 2025)',
             labels={'region': 'Region', 'growth_pct': 'Revenue Growth (%)'})
